work.abstract_text: Extending Vladimir Kruchinin's coefficient-transfer formula (2011, Theorem 8.1), we give a Lagrange-inversion proof of Werner Schulte's power-coefficient conjecture (OEIS A262082, revision 23, FORMULA, line 44, beginning 'B(m,n,k) = m/(n*k+m)', posed 10 September 2015) for all positive integers n,m and every k>=0. The alternating-sum conversion is the quadrinomial identity proved by Roberto Blanco Gómez (12 October 2026, Section 2). The coefficient formula extends to all integer parameters, with an explicit value when nk+m=0. An ordered-forest bijection proves Schulte's two nonnegative-path conjectures. The same argument gives the trinomial analogues, logarithms and substitutions, and Hanna's binomial-square exponential identities in the cross-referenced entries. The general positive-power transfer precedes the conjecture; the trinomial excursion family also has a later proof by Yan, who identifies the same family in Yang–Zhang–Yang's earlier work.

work.title: Proving Werner Schulte's coefficient and lattice-path conjectures by integer-parameter extensions of Kruchinin's formula
